title: An ability: res/abilities/<ability>.json
description: An ability's text, in the order of generated/abilities.txt; what it does is the battle code's. The text files take it with \from{abilities.name} and \from{abilities.description} (tools/text/text_sources.py).

description.description: The ability's description, with its line breaks

handlers_like.description: Paper White 2, an added ability's only: the original ability whose battle handlers it takes, registered with its own ID, so its popup shows its own name (tools/data/ability_list.py)

mold_breaker_ignores.description: Paper White 2, an added ability's only: Mold Breaker, Teravolt and Turboblaze ignore it, as they do Soundproof's and Levitate's (the generated PAPERWHITE2_ABILITY_MOLD_BREAKER_IGNORED, src/ov169/btl_tables.c)

retired.description: Paper White 2, an added ability's only: hidden from the editor's pickers (the species' abilities), keeping its ID and text, so Pokémon in saves that have it stay valid (tools/paperwhite2/abilities.py retire)
